source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of interference of microwaves and light (PDF 49-50).

blocks.text: 2.8 cm wavelength wale microwave saaman (Fig 15.6) se interference naqsha dekha ja sakta hai. Microwave transmitter ko dhaat ki rukawat mein do khalaon (gaps) ki taraf rakha jata hai. Microwaves do gaps par diffract ho kar aage ke ilaqe mein phailti hain, jahan probe receiver se pakri jati hain. Probe ko idhar udhar hilane se zyada shiddat (constructive interference) aur kam shiddat (destructive interference) ke ilaqe milte hain. Probe meter se, ya sunne ke qabil nateeje ke liye audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se jora ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar se dekhi bench. Baen taraf microwave transmitter dhaat ki chaadaron (metal sheets) ki qatar ki taraf hai jin mein do tang khala (gaps) hain. Gaps ke paar daen taraf microwave probe hai jo taron se meter se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.6: Microwaves se bhi interference ke asraat dikhaye ja sakte hain (kitab ki Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Roshni ka interference dikhane ka aasan tareeqa laser ko do slits se guzarna hai (Fig 15.7): siyah slide par do saaf lakeerein, millimetre ke chhote hisse ke faasle par. Screen par barabar faasle par roshni ke nuqton ka silsila, jinhein interference fringes kehte hain, wahan nazar aata hai jahan dono slits ki lehrein in phase pohanchti hain (constructive interference); darmiyan ke andhere hisse destructive interference ka nateeja hain. Yeh roshan aur andhere fringes do loudspeakers ke unche aur dheeme ilaqon ke barabar hain.

blocks.alt: Peeli warning label wala laser surkh shua double slit wali sheeshe ki slide par dalta hai. Slits se aath surkh lakeerein screen tak phailti hain jahan barabar faasle par surkh nuqton ki qatar banti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.7: Do slits se nikalti roshni ki shuaein aage ki jagah mein interference karti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hum jaanch sakte hain ke roshni dono slits se screen tak pohanchti hai. Andhere fringe par nuqta lagayein, phir aik slit dhaanp dein taake roshni sirf aik se guzre. Fringes ghaib ho jate aur roshni ki chauri patti, aik slit ka diffraction naqsha, nazar aati hai; jo nuqta andhera tha ab roshan hai. Doosra slit dhaanpne par bhi yahi hota hai. Yun roshni dono slits se aati hai, lekin andhere fringes par dono shuaein aik doosre ko khatam karti hain. Tez bulb bhi aise nataij de sakta hai, lekin laser zyada aasan hai kyunke us ki roshni tang, tez shua mein mutamarkiz hoti hai. Thomas Young ke paas 1801 mein pehli dafa tajurba karte waqt laser nahi tha.

blocks.prompt: Roshni aur awaz ki lehron ke double-slit intizam ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Mushabehat: aik generator se do coherent sources, aur jahan rasta farq poori ya aadhi wavelength ho wahan taqatwar aur kamzor jagahon ka naqsha. Farq: awaz lambi wavelength ki wajah se metre ya centimetre door loudspeakers ya gaps use karti, kaan ya microphone se pakri jati; roshni bohat chhoti wavelength ki wajah se millimetre ke hisse door slits aur screen chahti hai.

items: Do gaps se microwaves (2.8 cm): probe taqatwar aur kamzor jagahein dhoondta.
Double slit se laser: barabar faasle par roshan fringes.
Aik slit dhaanpne se fringes ghaib: roshni dono slits se aati.
